digest.component_or_area: MCP infrastructure / Jira bridge credential wiring
propositions: MCP server deployed without Jira credentials wired, causing bridge_check_access and all bridge operations to fail with missing_credentials error.
Three operator-seeded Jira parameters exist in AWS SSM (jira-url, jira-user, jira-api-token) created out-of-band, requiring terraform import blocks to avoid ParameterAlreadyExists collision.
JIRA_PROJECT environment variable is required by probe scope resolution but reads environment only, not rebar.toml config, causing missing_project failure without it.
Jira credentials (outbound integration) must degrade softly with optional reads; missing them should not abort fetch-secrets.sh or take the endpoint down.
Type split must be honored end-to-end: jira-url and jira-user as plain String parameters read without decryption, jira-api-token as SecureString read with decryption.
Four Jira variables must reach mcp container via env_file (.env) in both compose and mcp_run_new paths, never via -e flags that would clobber in the deploy shell.
